facts.name: Virginia standard deduction, Filing Status 1 and 3
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): $8,500 for taxable years beginning 2024-01-01 and before 2025-01-01 (single; married filing separately takes one-half of the married amount, also $8,500). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaStandardDeductionSingle">
  <Name>Virginia standard deduction, Filing Status 1 and 3</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): $8,500 for taxable years beginning 2024-01-01
        and before 2025-01-01 (single; married filing separately takes one-half of the married
        amount, also $8,500). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>8500</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia standard deduction, Filing Status 2
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): $17,000 for married persons filing jointly, taxable year 2024. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11.

    <Dollar>17000</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia personal exemption

facts.name: Virginia age deduction, last birth date for the full amount
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a): born on or before January 1, 1939, the full $12,000 regardless of income. A statutory date, kept with the figures so the file holds no date literal outside this block.

facts.name: Virginia age deduction income threshold, single
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): the $12,000 is reduced $1 for each $1 of adjusted federal adjusted gross income over $50,000 for single taxpayers.

facts.name: Virginia Earned Income Credit rate, nonrefundable

facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): for taxable years 2022 through 2024, 15% of the federal earned income credit, refundable, in place of either nonrefundable credit (20% from 2025, subdivision 3 b). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 16b.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCreditRate">

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction, maximum
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): up to $15,000 of military basic pay, reduced $1 for each $1 of basic pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 38.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction, maximum</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): up to $15,000 of military basic pay, reduced $1 for
        each $1 of basic pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. 2024 Form 760
        instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 38.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>

  </Derived>

facts.description: Va. facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsMaximum">
  <Name>Military benefits subtraction, maximum</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c): $30,000 of military benefits for taxable year 2024

        qualified military benefits, and Survivor Benefit Plan and other military benefits paid to a
        surviving spouse. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 60.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>30000</Dollar>
  </Derived>

facts.name: Commonwealth Savers deduction cap
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(a): "limited to $4,000 per prepaid tuition contract or college savings trust account" per return per taxable year. This prototype treats the contributions as one account; the carryforward of the excess to later years is out of scope.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCommonwealthSaversCap">
  <Name>Commonwealth Savers deduction cap</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(a): "limited to $4,000 per prepaid tuition contract or college
        savings trust account" per return per taxable year. This prototype treats the contributions as
        one account; the carryforward of the excess to later years is out of scope.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>4000</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Commonwealth Savers, last birth date for the no-cap rule
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to the $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 has attained 70 during tax year 2024.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCommonwealthSaversAge70BirthDateCutoff">
  <Name>Commonwealth Savers, last birth date for the no-cap rule</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to
        the $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 has attained 70 during tax year 2024.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Day>1954-12-31</Day>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 11, poverty guideline for the family size
facts.description: 2024 Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one, plus $5,380 for each more person. Family size is the You, Spouse and Dependents count (/vaPersonalExemptionCount).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPovertyGuideline">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 11, poverty guideline for the family size</Name>
  <Description>2024 Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one, plus $5,380 for each more person.
        Family size is the You, Spouse and Dependents count (/vaPersonalExemptionCount).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPovertyGuidelineFirstPerson"/>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPovertyGuidelineEachAdditionalPerson"/>
        <Subtract>
          <Minuend>
            <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
          </Minuend>
          <Subtrahends>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Subtrahends>
        </Subtract>
      </Multiply>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 13, Credit for Low-Income Individuals
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 times the personal and dependent exemptions (Schedule ADJ Line 12; not the 65 or older or blind ones), if the family qualifies.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 13, Credit for Low-Income Individuals</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 times the personal and dependent exemptions
        (Schedule ADJ Line 12; not the 65 or older or blind ones), if the family qualifies.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaQualifiesForCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaLowIncomeCreditPerExemption"/>
            <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 15, Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(2): 20% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 15, Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(2): 20% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaEarnedIncomeCreditRate"/>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
      </Multiply>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 16b, Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): 15% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 16b, Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): 15% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCreditRate"/>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
      </Multiply>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Standard deduction amount for this filing status
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b). Federal itemizers must itemize in Virginia (Line 10); that case is out of scope, so every return here takes the standard deduction.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaStandardDeductionForFilingStatus">
  <Name>Standard deduction amount for this filing status</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b). Federal itemizers must itemize in Virginia (Line
        10); that case is out of scope, so every return here takes the standard deduction.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaStandardDeductionMarried"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaStandardDeductionSingle"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions, Section A amount
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(a): $930 times the You, Spouse and Dependents count.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPersonalExemptions">
  <Name>Exemptions, Section A amount</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(a): $930 times the You, Spouse and Dependents count.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPersonalExemptionAmount"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions, Section B amount the filers qualify for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 times the 65 or older and Blind count, the spouse's boxes included. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions: these cannot be claimed with a Credit for Low-Income Individuals on Line 23 (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(4) bars every low-income credit when the filer or the spouse claims one).
facts.rawXml:

facts.name: Age deduction the primary filer qualifies for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older, $12,000 reduced by the income-based reduction, never below zero; otherwise $0. The disability subtraction that can be taken instead is out of scope.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerAgeDeductionAllowed">

    </Switch>

</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction the spouse qualifies for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5), for the spouse on a joint return, with the same rule as the primary filer: $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older, $12,000 reduced by the return's income-based reduction; otherwise $0. Assumption, from the Code's text: the deduction is "for individuals", and on a joint return "the taxpayer's adjusted federal adjusted gross income" is the joint AFAGI, so each spouse's $12,000 is reduced by the same excess over $75,000. If Virginia Tax's Age Deduction Worksheet instead reduces the couple's combined $24,000 once, this is the fact to change.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseAgeDeductionAllowed">

        the primary filer: $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older,
        $12,000 reduced by the return's income-based reduction; otherwise $0. Assumption, from the
        Code's text: the deduction is "for individuals", and on a joint return "the taxpayer's
        adjusted federal adjusted gross income" is the joint AFAGI, so each spouse's $12,000 is
        reduced by the same excess over $75,000. If Virginia Tax's Age Deduction Worksheet instead

        </Then>

    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction the filer qualifies for (Schedule ADJ code 38)
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): all basic pay up to $15,000; above that, $15,000 reduced dollar for dollar by the pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. Limited to what federal AGI includes, here W-2 wages. The cap is the household's /wages (exported to MeF): the federal per-filer figures (/primaryFilerWages, /formW2s/*/filer, /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) are not exported to states, so the primary filer's own wages cannot be read here; on a joint return the cap is therefore loose by the spouse's wages. Claimed on Line 7 only if the return does not claim a low-income credit (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtractionAllowed">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction the filer qualifies for (Schedule ADJ code 38)</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): all basic pay up to $15,000; above that, $15,000
        reduced dollar for dollar by the pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. Limited to
        what federal AGI includes, here W-2 wages. The cap is the household's /wages (exported to
        MeF): the federal per-filer figures (/primaryFilerWages, /formW2s/*/filer,
        /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) are not exported to states, so the primary filer's own
        wages cannot be read here; on a joint return the cap is therefore loose by the spouse's
        wages. Claimed on Line 7 only if the return does not claim a low-income credit (Va. Code
        § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryBasicPay"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum"/>
            </Right>
          </LessThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayPhasedOut"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Tax from the rate schedule, keeping the age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-320, taxable years from 1990: 2% of income not exceeding $3,000; 3% of income over $3,000 to $5,000; 5% of income over $5,000 to $17,000; 5.75% of income over $17,000. Written as the cumulative schedule the 2024 Form 760 instructions print: $60 at $3,000, $120 at $5,000, $720 at $17,000 (the /vaRateSchedule… figures). Rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxFromRateSchedule">
  <Name>Tax from the rate schedule, keeping the age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-320, taxable years from 1990: 2% of income not exceeding
        $3,000; 3% of income over $3,000 to $5,000; 5% of income over $5,000 to $17,000; 5.75% of
        income over $17,000. Written as the cumulative schedule the 2024 Form 760 instructions
        print: $60 at $3,000, $120 at $5,000, $720 at $17,000 (the /vaRateSchedule… figures).
        Rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket1Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Multiply>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate1"/>
              <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
            </Multiply>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket2Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket1Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate2"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket1Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket3Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket2Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate3"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket2Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket3Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate4"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket3Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Tax from the rate schedule, claiming a low-income credit

        <Case>

              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket2Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket1Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate2"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
